_renamed: Sample 1 became Porch & Party Studio on 22 Oct 2026 (owner's word). The slug, Worker, D1 and R2 keep their sample1 names: renaming them would orphan the data (README "Rename a studio").
_ownerEmail: Never in this file (public repo). Set at deploy time from the 0600 file <secrets dir>/sample1/OWNER_EMAIL by `npm run studio:secrets sample1` (README "Owner email"). No first-login link is needed.
_hostAccounts: Owner's word 22 Oct 2026 ("Yes, same as Hadiyah"): Porch & Party Studio runs studio email (the host's Resend, its own sending key and From address), AI writing (the host's OpenRouter, its own $0-limit key, free models only) and the job runner (the host's) on the host's accounts. Only the keys in hostKeys; validator host-keys-host-only pins the list.

hostSecrets._why: The host's job runner, studio email and AI writing (owner's word 22 Oct 2026). Everything else (Facebook, Pinterest, Buffer…) is the owner's own, pasted on Setup.
hostSecrets._notify: Owner's ruling 22 Oct 2026: every Porch & Party Studio email (heads-ups, alerts, reports, What's new) goes ONLY to the host, from the 0600 file <secrets dir>/sample1/NOTIFY_EMAIL; none to the owner. Login codes still go to whoever types their address (worker/services/email.ts routeRecipients).
hostSecrets._optional: file? = set when the 0600 secret file exists, otherwise a named stop: that service stays in practice mode (README Secrets).

photoPosts._why: Photo posts (shared/photoPosts.ts): one photo becomes a pack of posts that go out on their own with a heads-up and a Skip. On by the host's word, 22 Oct 2026.

sound._why: Owner, 22 Oct 2026: this studio's phone videos carry only background talk, so the camera sound is off by default (music plays instead; a voice over is added), and voice overs use a stock voice (Kokoro preset, Apache-2.0) until the owner picks another or records her own (Settings > Sound). shared/sound.ts.

contentRules._why: Porch & Party's rules, enforced in code (shared/contentRules.ts): never the word insured, no customer address, house number or face, prices only from this one list. Host's word, 22 Oct 2026. Her own face may show (her Brand Profile says the owner herself is fine to show), ownerFace "show": only the person working or talking to the camera, customers' faces are always blurred (jobs/protect.py).

whatsNew.title: New in your studio
lines: Add a photo and the studio makes a few posts from it.
Posts go to Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and Pinterest on their own.
You get an email the day before. Tap Skip to stop one.
Faces and house numbers are blurred before anything posts.
